description.value: Blackwood Lane Winery is a family-run estate operated by father-and-son team Carlos and Daniel Lee, who use traditional French winemaking methods without chemicals or mechanical pumps to produce award-winning Okanagan wines. Recently relocated from Aldergrove to Penticton, it sits at the very first stop on the Naramata Bench, making it a natural pull-off for cyclists riding that iconic route. The tasting room is open seven days a week and the online shop offers store pickup for those who want to load a bottle into their panniers.

address.value: 134 Lower Bench Road, Penticton, BC V2A 1A8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address, phone, and name. The About page confirms this is a real, recently relocated winery now operating at 134 Lower Bench Road on the Naramata Bench in Penticton, run by the Lee family. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the shop page confirms wine can be purchased for pickup/takeout, which qualifies as takeout for a Food & Drink listing. The 604 area code is explained by the winery's prior location in Aldergrove before relocating to Penticton.
